observed.attributionRationale: Official Blackstone, FTC and transaction materials identify a closed majority investment by Blackstone Energy Transition Partners IV through Rocket Purchaser, L.L.C.; the approved after-image retains both the disclosed fund and acquisition vehicle.

Official TPG, Blackstone and closing materials identify TPG Rise Climate as the majority investor; they do not identify TPG Peppertree Fund X or another separate fund vehicle, so the disclosed strategy is retained as a direct program.

TXNM's filings identify Troy TopCo LP as the exact former $400 million PIPE investment vehicle, but do not disclose the underlying Blackstone infrastructure fund; the stale BETP IV estimate is removed after the shares were fully cancelled and repaid in July 2026.
